test_qcut_basic: test the qcut method to bin a polars Series into quantile intervals using percentile breakpoints
test_qcut_lazy_schema: test the qcut method on a LazyFrame to verify the output schema produces a Categorical dtype
test_qcut_n_bins: test the qcut method with an integer number of bins, custom labels, and left_closed intervals
test_qcut_include_breaks: test the qcut method with include_breaks=True to return a struct containing breakpoint values and category labels
test_qcut_null_values: test the qcut method to verify null values in the input Series are preserved as null in the output
